entries.title: Colony Wars

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation with an owned disc image for modern display options while preserving the original PlayStation game.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with optional emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: Colony Wars was released for PlayStation and its branching mission structure is contained in that original release; no sourced higher-fidelity port, remaster, or remake was identified.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original PlayStation disc on compatible hardware, or use DuckStation with an owned copy.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation space-combat simulator with branching mission outcomes.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and therefore the complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate release was identified; the PlayStation release is both the original and complete version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or modern rerelease was identified.
